ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- (attributes.properties.messageId default uuid()) as String
%dw 2.0 output application/java --- (attributes.properties.correlationId default uuid()) as String

logger.doc:name: Log Process Layer Entry
logger.message: #['[LAYER: PROCESS] Fulfilment Consumer Triggered | CorrelationID: ' ++ (vars.correlationId default '')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output text/plain var totalAmount = vars.orderData.orderTotal default 0 var taxableAmount = round((totalAmount / 1.18) * 100) / 100 var totalTax = totalAmount - taxableAmount var halfTax = round((totalTax / 2) * 100) / 100 --- "==========================================================
" ++ "TAX INVOICE
" ++ "==========================================================
" ++ "Invoice Number: " ++ vars.invoiceNum ++ "
" ++ "Invoice Date: " ++ (now() as String {format: "dd-MMM-yyyy"}) ++ "
" ++ "Order Number: " ++ vars.orderId ++ "
" ++ "Order Date: " ++ (now() as String {format: "dd-MMM-yyyy"}) ++ "

" ++ "SELLER:
" ++ "NPN Retail Private Limited
" ++ "Plot 22, Ambattur Industrial Estate, Chennai 600058
" ++ "GSTIN: 33AABCN1234M1Z7

" ++ "BILL TO:
" ++ vars.orderData.customer.name ++ "
" ++ vars.orderData.billingAddress.line1 ++ ", " ++ vars.orderData.billingAddress.city ++ ", " ++ vars.orderData.billingAddress.state ++ " " ++ vars.orderData.billingAddress.postalCode ++ "
" ++ "GSTIN: " ++ (vars.orderData.billingAddress.gstin default "N/A") ++ "

" ++ "ITEMS:
" ++ "----------------------------------------------------------
" ++ ((vars.orderData.items map ((item, idx) -> (idx + 1) ++ ". " ++ item.sku ++ " | " ++ item.productName ++ " | QTY: " ++ item.quantity ++ " | RATE: " ++ item.unitPrice ++ " | TOTAL: " ++ item.lineTotal )) joinBy "
") ++ "
" ++ "----------------------------------------------------------
" ++ "Taxable Amount: " ++ (taxableAmount as String) ++ "
" ++ "CGST 9%: " ++ (halfTax as String) ++ "
" ++ "SGST 9%: " ++ (halfTax as String) ++ "
" ++ "PAYABLE TOTAL: " ++ (totalAmount as String) ++ "
" ++ "Payment: " ++ (vars.orderData.paymentMethod default "PREPAID") ++ " Ref: " ++ (vars.orderData.paymentReference default "N/A") ++ "
" ++ "Status: PAID
" ++ "==========================================================
"

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "eventType": "ORDER_FULFILLED", "correlationId": vars.correlationId, "orderId": vars.orderId, "invoiceNumber": vars.invoiceNum, "invoicePath": vars.invoiceFileName, "customerEmail": vars.orderData.customer.email, "customerName": vars.orderData.customer.name, "backorderedLines": vars.backorderedLinesCount, "payableTotal": vars.orderData.orderTotal, "currency": vars.orderData.currency, "shippingAddress": vars.orderData.shippingAddress, "items": vars.orderData.items }

logger.doc:name: Log Fulfilment Failure
logger.message: #['[PROCESS ERROR] Routing to DLQ. Error: ' ++ (error.description default '')]

logger.doc:name: Log Process Layer Entry
logger.message: #['[LAYER: PROCESS] Notification Consumer Triggered | CorrelationID: ' ++ (vars.correlationId default '')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- "Dear " ++ (vars.notifyData.customerName default "Customer") ++ ",

" ++ "Thank you for your order. We have received your payment and your order is now being prepared for dispatch.

" ++ "Order Number: " ++ (vars.orderId default "") ++ "
" ++ "Invoice Number: " ++ (vars.notifyData.invoiceNumber default "") ++ "
" ++ "Payable Total: " ++ (vars.notifyData.currency default "INR") ++ " " ++ (vars.notifyData.payableTotal as String default "0") ++ "

" ++ "Delivery Address:
" ++ (vars.notifyData.shippingAddress.line1 default "") ++ ", " ++ (vars.notifyData.shippingAddress.city default "") ++ "

" ++ "Your tax invoice is attached to this email.

" ++ "Regards,
NPN Retail Customer Care"
